prompt: Call bash exactly twice, one after the other, with no text in between and no text before the first call. First call: description "List the directory", command: ls. Second call: description "Wait for the build", command: sleep 15 && echo built.

steps.until: (?m)^● Waiting for the build · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 15 && echo built \([3-9]s\)
(?m)^● Waiting for the build · \d+s *\n +⎿ +\$ sleep 15 && echo built \((?:[7-9]|1[0-2])s\)
